<!-- reader-guide -->
按 marker 把 cluster 收成大类（HSPC、B、中性粒等）。CellTypist 只作参考。

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pacman::p_load(Seurat, tidyverse, presto, cowplot, SCpubr, scop, qs2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/home/han/Desktop/guoqiang/stroke_bm/stroke_bm_Rproj")
setwd("/home/han/Desktop/guoqiang/stroke_bm/stroke_bm_Rproj")
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
alpha <- .03
pt_size <- .03
raster <- FALSE
raster_dpi <- c(3000, 3000)
min_cutoff <- "q10"
max_cutoff <- "q90"
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
res_path <- "results/dim_reduction"
obj_path <- "data/rdata/dim_reduction"
if (!dir.exists(res_path)) dir.create(res_path, recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(obj_path)) dir.create(obj_path, recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists("results/figures")) dir.create("results/figures", recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
seurat_object <-
  qs_read(
    "data/rdata/dim_reduction/seurat_object_clustered.qs2",
    nthreads = 10
  )
Layers(seurat_object)
DefaultLayer(seurat_object@assays$RNA)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
resolutions <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2)
sc_markers <- list()

for (res in resolutions) {
  col_name <- paste0("harmony_clusters_", res)

  Idents(seurat_object) <- col_name

  cat(sprintf("\n=== Resolution %s Cell Counts ===\n", res))
  print(table(Idents(seurat_object)))

  sc_markers[[paste0("all_markers_", res)]] <- FindAllMarkers(
    seurat_object,
    only.pos = TRUE
  )
}

qs_save(sc_markers, file.path(obj_path, "sc_markers.qs2"), nthreads = 10)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_grid(
  ncol = 3,
  DimPlot(
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 与下方 cluster_map 对齐：marker 表和 cluster 映射必须用同一个分辨率（res 2）
marker_table <-
  sc_markers[["all_markers_2"]] |>
    group_by(cluster) |>
    slice_head(n = 20) |>
    group_by(cluster) |>
    mutate(rank = paste0("Top_", row_number())) |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = rank, names_from = cluster, values_from = gene)

# View(marker_table)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
DimPlot(
  seurat_object,
  reduction = "umap_harmony",
  group.by = "annot",
  pt.size = .1, alpha = .1,
  raster = FALSE, label = TRUE
) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

ggsave("results/dim_reduction/umap_harmony_first_annot.pdf",
       width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 600)
```
